description: Fork of exp722 (E=384, d_v=64, hybrid_smooth, residual/emb_resid NAP=6, bs=16 8K = 1.4054 @ 201.33M, new <210M SOTA at 65.5M-tok compute). Single change: scale compute to exp712 regime — device_batch_size 16 -> 48, n_steps 8K -> 16K, total_batch_size 8192 -> 24576. Total compute = 393M tokens (~6x exp722). Tests whether NAP=6 on residual modules (gain at 65.5M-tok: -11.7 mb vs exp708) transfers to 393M-tok regime. Comparison anchors: exp712 (NAP=5 residuals, same compute) = 1.2080 @ 179.32M; exp722 (NAP=6 residuals, less compute) = 1.4054.
